title: Text glyphs show a yellow sliver beside them at some zoom levels in the DSL graph view (since the regenerated font atlas)
description: User 2026-10-25 (screenshot of a spline_ring box, '8 ms 1028.5 MiB'): at certain zoom levels a thin yellow sliver appears at the side of glyphs, on dozens of letters and digits when zooming the DSL graph view; not at high or low zoom; hard to hit exactly, so it looks numeric. Likely since CRAW-78 regenerated res/opensans.png/json (em 128, pxrange 48, padded quads) and finished the border band in sdf.fs: suspects are texture-coordinate bleed into the neighbouring glyph or padding at a mipmap level, the border band's screen-pixel range at some scales, or the msdf/true-distance mix in sdf.fs. Reproduce by sweeping the graph camera's zoom in small steps and screenshotting text (image-diff to find the frames), fix at the source.
definition-of-done:
1. A zoom sweep of the DSL graph view shows no slivers (screenshots).
2. 2D UI and 3D labels look as before.
3. A test or check that catches bleed (e.g. atlas padding vs the max sampled mip).
testing-plan: 1. Live zoom sweep through ixdar-cli on the graph view (Ctrl+G) of IMG_4112.
